resources.string: Measures the underlying network. A running RIPDPI VPN or proxy stops before the scan, which can interrupt calls and downloads.
Requested scope: through the active RIPDPI VPN or local proxy. Results cover the tested targets, not every app.
Automatic resume is off. Restart the connection after the scan.
Automatic resume is on. RIPDPI will try to restore the previous connection after the scan unless you stop it; restoration can fail.
Requested scope: the underlying network without the active RIPDPI connection. Strategy trials can use temporary candidates; this does not establish active VPN connectivity.
%1$s · direct network only · unavailable in command-line mode
Tests the running RIPDPI VPN path. The active VPN route must be observable at launch; results cover the tested targets, not every app.
Tests through the running RIPDPI local proxy. Its listener must match the planned endpoint; results cover the tested targets, not every app.
RIPDPI is reconnecting. Wait for the connection to finish before testing its active path.
